lure: A grandchild had an accident and needs money now
ask: Send 2,000 euros at once and keep it secret

message.subject: Message vocal WhatsApp (transcription)
message.body: Mamie, j'ai eu un accident, envoie 2 000 € tout de suite, n'en parle pas à papa. C'est urgent, garde ça secret.

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: This is probably not Hadrien.
reasons: The call comes from an unknown number.
Urgency and secrecy are the marks of a scam; call him back on his usual number.
